title: Caramelized Onion Pasta
description: A surprisingly delicious pasta dish with no meat or cheese, featuring deeply caramelized onions and a bright lemon finish.

ingredients.item: yellow onions or 3 large yellow onions
Olive oil or sun-dried tomato juice for drizzling
Little bit of chopped fresh basil
About a cup of pasta water, reserved

steps: Mix sun-dried tomatoes, paprika, black pepper, salt, and parsley flakes together.
Place the prepared onions in a baking dish. Add the mixed seasonings. Place the whole clove of garlic in the center.
Drizzle generously with olive oil or sun-dried tomato juice.
Cover with an inverted second sheet pan or a stainless pan over the dish and bake in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 1 hour.
After 30 minutes, toss the onions and return to the oven.
About 20 minutes before the onions are done, cook the farfalle pasta according to package directions.
Once the caramelized onions are out of the oven, squeeze the roasted garlic out into the onion mixture.
Add the cooked pasta to the caramelized onion mixture.
Stir in the fresh parsley, coconut milk, and fresh basil.
Add about a cup of the reserved pasta water.
Squeeze the juice of one lemon over the pasta.
notes:
The author found this recipe to be surprisingly delicious and healthy, a flavor explosion that they would make again.
